newsitem.title: FRANCE: Exporters eye French Coface wheat sale to Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Exporters eye French Coface wheat sale to Algeria.

text.p: Algeria still has credit outstanding to buy 84,000 tonnes of French wheat under an existing Coface credit line, French grain exporters and banking sources said on Monday.
Algeria has launched a tender for the import of 125,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat for shipment between April 1 and June 15.
It is planning to import 50,000 tonnes of wheat in April, 50,000 tonnes in May and 25,000 tonnes in the first half of June, they said.
Exporters said French wheat is competitive against other origins on April shipments, with recent sales valuing French wheat at around $142 per tonne, Fob.
But French wheat will face competition from Canadian and Australian supplies on May shipments and from the U.S. on June shipments, they said.
